 In the Rolex Paris Masters Round of 32 on Wednesday, No. 43-ranked Matteo Berrettini takes on No. 38 Ugo Humbert.
 In this match, Humbert is the favorite (-120) versus Berrettini (-105) .
 Rolex Paris Masters Info 
 Tournament: The Rolex Paris Masters
 Round: Round of 32
 Date: Wednesday, November 4
 Venue: Paris La Defense Arena
 Location: Paris, France
 Court Surface: Hard
